Hey Jordan / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency gains on our long-context pipelines were obvious. Our engineering lead (Priya) and I were talking and we'd like to run a focused, hands-on "technical jam" with a small Redwood squad to get the integration to a runnable POC inside our environment.

High-level ask: pair on a two-day sprint where we wire up the LangChain/LlamaIndex client flow, attach Redwood trace hooks for token-level attribution, and validate live rollback to a smaller quantized model if we hit perf regressions. We want something we can hand off to our platform team afterwards (sandbox-ready).

Are you available to do this the week of Oct 19? Also curious if you can bring someone from the tracing/observability side — we want to confirm the minimal runbook to pass back to our SREs.

Best,
Ian

- Dates: Oct 20 (day 1) + Oct 21 (day 2) — two 4-hour blocks (09:00-13:00 PT) to accommodate your on-call windows.
- Goal: produce a working sandbox demo (LangChain or LlamaIndex flow + Redwood trace hooks + fallback to quantized variant).
- Deliverables: sandbox credentials verified, sample prompt suite, runbook for trace hook setup, short SOW for signatures.
- Roles: 
  - Redwood: Jordan (partnership lead / coordinator), Marissa (integration engineer), Vanessa (observability lead)
  - QuantumBridge: Priya (eng lead), Ian (platform), 1x backend engineer (TBD)

Prep items we need from you by Oct 13:
1) Sandbox access for a test service account (minimal IAM + GPU instance) — a credential file will do.
2) A short list of 5 representative prompts/queries and sample datasets we plan to run.
3) Any security constraints (eg: no external egress, specific KMS requirement).

Attachments: I attached a rough SOW (sow-draft-v1.pdf) and a short trace runbook draft (runbook-trace-hook.md) for review. We'll update after the jam.

If Oct 20–21 doesn't work for you, propose two alternatives next week and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward.

Thanks Priya — saw the sandbox creds and verified connectivity (thanks for the quick turnaround). Short answers/questions below: 

- Which client first: start with LangChain if your team already has agent flows; it's the least friction to wire into a running service and lets us exercise streaming + function/tool calling. If your primary surface is retrieval-heavy (document search + Q&A), we can swap to LlamaIndex on day 2.

- Tracing footprint (Vanessa): minimal changes — we'll provide a small middleware (runbook-trace-hook.md) that plugs into your request pipeline and emits trace spans/token attribution to your tracing export endpoint. No KMS changes needed for the token-level metadata; if you want to obfuscate raw prompts we'll add an optional redact step that references your KMS.

Agenda (confirmed):
Day 1 (Oct 20) — LangChain wiring, stream + function call demo, trace hook + sample traces
Day 2 (Oct 21) — LlamaIndex retrieval demo, fallback to quantized model, perf regression test + checklist handoff

Success criteria (what we demo live):
- End-to-end sample prompt produces expected output within your latency SLOs with trace spans visible in your tracing dashboard
- Fallback to quantized model functions and maintains throughput target
- Handed-off runbook + SOW signed or in flight

I've attached the SOW draft (sow-draft-v1.pdf) — if everything looks good we'll ask for a signature and schedule an invoice after the sprint.

If you're good, I’ll send calendar invites for the two blocks and route a shared Google Drive folder for artifacts.

Cheers,
Jordan
